grades.question: What makes a normal move legal, can the same warriors move repeatedly, and do rivers count as paths?
grades.expected_answer: Move more than zero warriors/pawns along one linking path to an adjacent clearing; rule origin or destination or both. Same pieces can move repeatedly. Rivers are not paths unless explicitly treated as such.

grades.question: Describe battle from ambush through removal: foiling, early ending, dice limits, extra hits, removal priorities and who scores removed buildings/tokens.
grades.expected_answer: Defender may ambush matching clearing; attacker may foil with matching ambush. Unfoiled ambush deals two immediate hits; discard defender ambush, end battle if no attacking warriors/pawns remain. Before-roll effects, roll high attacker/low defender, rolled hits capped by own warriors, after-roll effects, count hits including uncapped extra hits and defenseless extra attacker hit if no defending warriors, then deal hits. Each side chooses own removals, warriors first. Whoever removes enemy building/token scores one, including defender.

observed.answer: Battle order is Ambush, before-roll effects, roll, after-roll effects, count hits, deal hits. Defender may play one matching ambush (birds wild); attacker may foil with a matching ambush. A foiled ambush deals none; otherwise defender immediately deals two hits, not capped by its warriors, and battle ends if the attacker has no warriors or pawns left. Higher die is attacker's rolled hits and lower die defender's (Alliance defending reverses dice); each side's rolled hits are capped by its own battle warriors, while Vagabond uses undamaged swords instead. At equal dice both deal equal results. Extra hits are added uncapped, ignored hits subtracted; a defender with no warriors gives the attacker one defenseless extra hit (Vagabond instead checks for undamaged swords). Each hit removes an opposing piece; its owner chooses order but must remove all warriors before buildings/tokens, and also chooses order of its removal-triggered effects. Both sides deal their counted hits even if warriors were removed after the roll. The player removing an enemy building/token scores one VP each, whether attacker or defender and even outside battle.
observed.evidence: Actions → Shared movement, crafting and battle: Battle (4.3), six numbered steps.
